title: Record 158 Million Shoppers Expected During Super Saturday

facts.fact: More than 158 million consumers were expected to shop on the last Saturday before Christmas in 2022, according to an annual survey by the National Retail Federation and Prosper Insights & Analytics.
facts.quote: More than 158 million consumers are expected to shop on the last Saturday before Christmas this year, according to the annual survey released today by the National Retail Federation and Prosper Insights & Analytics.

facts.fact: The expected Super Saturday shopper count was approximately 10 million more than the prior year's expected number.
facts.quote: This figure is approximately 10 million more than last year’s expected number of Super Saturday shoppers

facts.fact: The 158.5 million expected Super Saturday shoppers were the highest number since NRF first began tracking this data in 2016.
facts.quote: the highest number since NRF first started tracking this data in 2016.

facts.fact: Of the 158.5 million anticipated Super Saturday shoppers, 44.1 million (28%) planned to shop only in stores.
facts.quote: Of the 158.5 million anticipated Super Saturday shoppers, 44.1 million (28%) plan to shop only in stores

facts.fact: Of the 158.5 million anticipated Super Saturday shoppers, 42.2 million (27%) planned to shop only online.
facts.quote: 42.2 million (27%) plan to shop only online

facts.fact: Of the 158.5 million anticipated Super Saturday shoppers, 72.2 million (46%) planned to shop both in stores and online.
facts.quote: 72.2 million (46%) plan to shop both in stores and online.

facts.fact: As of early December 2022, holiday shoppers said they had completed about half (53%) of their holiday purchases.
facts.quote: as of early December, holiday shoppers said they had completed about half (53%) of their purchases.

facts.fact: Holiday shoppers planned to finish their holiday purchases online (47%), at department stores (37%), at discount stores (27%), at clothing/accessories stores (24%) and at grocery stores (19%).
facts.quote: They plan to finish their holiday purchases online (47%), at department stores (37%), at discount stores (27%)

facts.fact: Clothing was the top gift consumers had bought so far, at 50%, followed by toys (34%), gift cards (28%), books and other media (26%), and food or candy (23%).
facts.quote: The top gifts consumers have bought so far include clothing (50%), toys (34%), gift cards (28%), books and other media (26%), and food or candy (23%).

facts.fact: 28% of holiday shoppers planned to give a gift of experience in 2022, up from 23% the prior year.
facts.quote: This year, 28% of holiday shoppers plan to give a gift of experience such as tickets to a concert or sporting event

facts.fact: The 28% gift-of-experience share was the highest since NRF began asking this question in 2015.
facts.quote: is the highest since NRF began asking consumers this question in 2015.

facts.fact: 70% of consumers said their shopping plans included buying after Dec. 25, on par with pre-pandemic levels.
facts.quote: 70% say their shopping plans include buying after Dec. 25. This is on par with pre-pandemic levels for post-Christmas shopping.

facts.fact: Super Saturday fell eight days before Christmas in 2022.
facts.quote: With Super Saturday falling eight days before Christmas

facts.fact: The press release was published on December 12, 2022.
